[Intro: one chopped female word, soft pad]
(Easy)

[Beat Enters: light skipping drums, round sub bass]
(Easy, ea-, easy)

[Section A: the word re-pitched into a melody, harp plucks]
(Ea-, ea-, easy)
(Easy)

producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 128 BPM, 4/4 with a skipping two-step rhythm, G major. Light, fresh and gentle.

VOICE: No sung verses. One word, 'easy', sung by a woman with a soft, clear voice, chopped into syllables and re-pitched to play a melody. It is heard once whole and unprocessed in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: Light, skipping garage-style drums with a soft kick, a round sub bass, plucked harp notes, a warm pad, a small bell, birdsong, lapping water.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the word. 0:16 Beat enters. 0:46 Section A, melody. 1:30 Break, birdsong and haze. 2:00 The word, whole. 2:06 Beat returns, an octave up. 2:50 Outro, harp and one bird, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2020 melodic electronic: clean, airy and detailed, drums light, sub soft, lots of space.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The beat stopping for birdsong at 1:30, and the one unprocessed 'Easy' at 2:00.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 8 a.m. A light, skipping track for the first swim, with a pause in the middle to float.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Stiff, loosening, still, gliding.
